# Assessment Supplementary Documents

This directory contains the supplementary documents successfully copied from the ServiceFabric assessment facts.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — Deployment topology and component relationships for the three container services.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Service Fabric configuration sources, runtime toggles, and redacted secret references.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Deployment and runtime data flow visible from the scoped manifests.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — Declared Service Fabric build dependency and project-level compatibility notes.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — SQL deployment and the limits of the data model available in this workspace.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — Manifest-defined service endpoints and communication boundaries; application routes are unavailable.
